notes.title: Steam Overlay is working - and much more!
notes.content:
There have been loads of updates and bug fixes in the past week or two!

First thing to note is that the Steam Overlay is working :D 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30697039/125391a0c8a8e522f11c26457e0ddede8e53bd04.jpg

Beyond that, there have been dozens of fixes to Interstellar Invaders! 


    Two-player CoOp mode is available from the start of the game
    You can now access CoOp mode from the menu screen mid game
    The first boss has been updated to have additional obsticles in CoOp mode
    Colors work properly while in Inverted mode
    Other bug fixes that I can't remember!

notes.title: New features update!
notes.content:
Hello folks! 

Loads of new things have been added to Interstellar Invaders!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30697039/fcce6fe7a626a27888796fff9a8bce30160acdff.png

'Continues' have been added to the game - as something that can be earned if you get far enough.  This is a big improvement on the balance of the game!

Co-op mode has been greatly refined and dozens of songs have been added to the game, to add divirsity to the soundscape.

On the near horizon: Steam Achievents!
